zh-CN.summary: 《TI 模拟器》Windows x64 免安装便携测试包，面向小范围试玩体验完整赛程与局内决策，下载 ZIP 解压后即可运行。
changelog: 打包 Windows x64 免安装便携测试版，解压后双击 Start-Game.bat 即可进入。
同步提供 GitHub Release 直链与百度网盘备用镜像（提取码已附在链接中）。
附带中英文新手上手说明，整理了首局流程与常见启动提示。
knownIssues: 本阶段仅构建了 Windows x64 版本，暂未提供 macOS 与 Linux 包。
个人测试包未做商业代码签名，Windows 首次启动若弹出保护提示，可点“更多信息 → 仍要运行”。
测试期数值与界面仍在迭代，如遇某个镜像下载缓慢可切换另一镜像。

en.summary: TI Simulator Windows x64 portable playtest archive for trying a full tournament run and checkpoint decisions—just unzip to a normal folder and launch.
changelog: Packaged the Windows x64 portable playtest zip—extract and launch via Start-Game.bat.
Provided both GitHub Release and Baidu Netdisk download mirrors.
Added Chinese and English starter play guides covering setup and first-series tips.
knownIssues: Windows x64 only for now; macOS and Linux builds are not available yet.
Because this indie preview zip is unsigned, Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on first launch.
Balance and UI are still being tuned; switch mirrors if one download link is slow in your region.

note: This file is maintained in sync with src/data/downloads.ts.
